# Inline Alert

Inline alerts surface page-level messages in the flow of content. Five semantic types (neutral, info, error, warning, success) with an accent edge, an optional colored background, an optional dismiss button, and optional action buttons. Ported from the DGA library's dga-inline-alert component.

**Stylesheet:** `components/inline-alert/inline-alert.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes for configuring inline alerts, mapped from the library's dga-inline-alert API.

| Class | Type | Library prop | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.inline-alert` | Base | — | Root container. Full-width, accent edge on the reading side. |
| .inline-alert--neutral / --info / --error / --warning / --success | Modifier | `type` | Semantic type. Sets the accent edge and the featured icon colors. |
| `.inline-alert--{type}-bg` | Modifier | `colored` | Colored background variant: 25-tint background with a 200-tint border. |
| `.inline-alert__header` | Element | — | Icon + text + close row. Add --centered when there is no helper text. |
| `.inline-alert__icon` | Element | — | 40px featured icon circle, tinted by the alert type. |
| `.inline-alert__title` | Element | `lead-text` | Alert heading. Pair with .text-md-semibold. |
| `.inline-alert__content` | Element | `helper-text` | Optional supporting copy. Pair with .text-sm-regular. |
| `.inline-alert__close` | Element | `is-close-button` | Dismiss slot. Contains a transparent icon-only design-system button. |
| .inline-alert__action / .inline-alert__action-mobile | Element | isaction-buttons, buttons-list | Action row using design-system buttons. The mobile variant stacks full-width under 600px. |

## Types

Five semantic types. The accent edge and the featured icon communicate severity; the layout stays identical.

```html
<div class="inline-alert inline-alert--neutral">
    <div class="inline-alert__header">
        <div class="inline-alert__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-help-circle"></span></div>
        <div class="inline-alert__body">
            <h4 class="inline-alert__title text-md-semibold">Neutral alert</h4>
            <p class="inline-alert__content text-sm-regular">A general message that does not carry a semantic
                state.</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="inline-alert inline-alert--info">
    <div class="inline-alert__header">
        <div class="inline-alert__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-help-circle"></span></div>
        <div class="inline-alert__body">
            <h4 class="inline-alert__title text-md-semibold">Info alert</h4>
            <p class="inline-alert__content text-sm-regular">Something the user should know before they
                continue.</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="inline-alert inline-alert--success">
    <div class="inline-alert__header">
        <div class="inline-alert__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span></div>
        <div class="inline-alert__body">
            <h4 class="inline-alert__title text-md-semibold">Success alert</h4>
            <p class="inline-alert__content text-sm-regular">The request was submitted successfully.</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="inline-alert inline-alert--warning">
    <div class="inline-alert__header">
        <div class="inline-alert__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-alert-02"></span></div>
        <div class="inline-alert__body">
            <h4 class="inline-alert__title text-md-semibold">Warning alert</h4>
            <p class="inline-alert__content text-sm-regular">Review the highlighted fields before submitting.
            </p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="inline-alert inline-alert--error">
    <div class="inline-alert__header">
        <div class="inline-alert__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-help-circle"></span></div>
        <div class="inline-alert__body">
            <h4 class="inline-alert__title text-md-semibold">Error alert</h4>
            <p class="inline-alert__content text-sm-regular">The request could not be completed. Try again
                later.</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Colored Background

## With Action Buttons

Alerts can carry actions, indented to align with the text column. Under 600px the actions stack full-width below the message.

```html
<div class="inline-alert inline-alert--warning">
    <div class="inline-alert__header">
        <div class="inline-alert__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-alert-02"></span></div>
        <div class="inline-alert__body">
            <h4 class="inline-alert__title text-md-semibold">Your session is about to expire</h4>
            <p class="inline-alert__content text-sm-regular">You will be signed out in 5 minutes. Extend the
                session to keep working.</p>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="inline-alert__action">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-subtle btn-small">Extend session</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-transparent btn-small">Sign out</button>
    </div>
    <div class="inline-alert__action-mobile">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Extend session</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-transparent">Sign out</button>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Dismissible

An icon-only transparent button in the header dismisses the alert. On mobile it anchors to the top corner.

```html
<div class="inline-alert inline-alert--success inline-alert--success-bg">
    <div class="inline-alert__header">
        <div class="inline-alert__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span></div>
        <div class="inline-alert__body">
            <h4 class="inline-alert__title text-md-semibold">Profile updated</h4>
            <p class="inline-alert__content text-sm-regular">Your changes were saved.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="inline-alert__close">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-transparent btn-icon-only btn-small" aria-label="Dismiss" onclick="this.closest('.inline-alert').remove()">
                <span class="icon dga-icon-multiplication-sign"></span>
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Title Only

Without helper text the header centers the icon against the single line.

```html
<div class="inline-alert inline-alert--info">
    <div class="inline-alert__header inline-alert__header--centered">
        <div class="inline-alert__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-help-circle"></span></div>
        <div class="inline-alert__body">
            <h4 class="inline-alert__title text-md-semibold" style="margin-bottom: 0;">A new version of this
                service is available.</h4>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## RTL Layout

The accent edge, icon, and dismiss button mirror automatically in right-to-left layouts.

```html
<div class="inline-alert inline-alert--success inline-alert--success-bg">
    <div class="inline-alert__header">
        <div class="inline-alert__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span></div>
        <div class="inline-alert__body">
            <h4 class="inline-alert__title text-md-semibold">تم إرسال الطلب بنجاح</h4>
            <p class="inline-alert__content text-sm-regular">سيتم إشعارك عند اكتمال المعالجة.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="inline-alert__close">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-transparent btn-icon-only btn-small" aria-label="إغلاق">
                <span class="icon dga-icon-multiplication-sign"></span>
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```
